highlights_headline: The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.156 release improves platform support, rendering synchronization, and managed image and text performance.
highlights_body: It adds Uno Platform 7 support, raises Apple deployment minimums, and corrects native string and stream lifetime handling.

breaking.title: Apple deployment minimums raised
breaking.body: Apple applications must target the newer deployment minimums required by this release before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled m156 renderer with the latest upstream bug fixes and toolchain refresh.

bullets.lead: Native string creation no longer reads beyond its input buffer
bullets.detail: SKData string creation writes directly to managed data storage, correcting native buffer handling.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain stale data
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention to release data when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows the display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh timing for smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: WebGPU native code is included in SkiaSharp
bullets.detail: Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp within libSkiaSharp.a for WebGPU consumers.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing allocate less
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed pixel copies, pools HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers, and avoids native feature-string allocations.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added WebGPU native integration and Uno Platform 7 support
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and improved browser sample coverage
contributor_summaries.Saad-elnagar: Removed an obsolete native dependency notice
